data.name: Printable ammo BETA
data.shortDescription: Mod that allows ammo to be 3d printed
data.description:
# This mod allows ammo to be 3D-printed!


**Note: the mod hasn't been balanced perfectly yet. There are config sliders for balancing, experiment with what works best. Beta mod, please report bugs.**

This mod might later become obsolete due to another project I am working on. Be sure to check the Discord server for updates.

versions.changelog:
# Patch 0.1.3

This patch aims to fix several bugs that have been found during playtesting and reported on the Discord.

### BUG FIXES

- Fixed rifle ammo printing 9mm ammo instead of actual rifle ammo

- Fixed rifle ammo being able to be printed for free

- Fixed print time being set to anything other than 1.0 causing the printer to break.
Bugfix for rifle ammo prrint cost
